title: What Parameter Golf taught us about AI-assisted research
summary: Parameter Golf brought together 1,000+ participants and 2,000+ submissions to explore AI-assisted machine learning research, coding agents, quantization, and novel model design under strict constraints.
body: Parameter Golf brought together 1,000+ participants and 2,000+ submissions to explore AI-assisted machine learning research, coding agents, quantization, and novel model design under strict constraints.
summaryZh: Parameter Golf活动汇集了超过1000名参与者，通过2000多项提交，深入探讨了AI辅助机器学习研究、编码智能体、量化技术及模型设计。该活动展示了在严格约束条件下利用AI进行复杂研发的潜力。

aiReview.reasonZh: 通过大规模竞赛探索了AI辅助研究与编码智能体的实际应用边界。
